mentions.name: MalleableTodo
mentions.description: A demo/experiment in malleable software: a todo app where each user can use an LLM to rewrite their own UI to add features and customizations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Published a demo/experiment under MalleableTodo [1] - and so far seen some pretty strange use cases...

Essentially, just allows each user to use an LLM to rewrite their own UI to add features/customisation.
